Welcome to Youwo AI — your AI-powered all-in-one personal assistant for notes, designed to support your learning, work, and life.You can input information anytime, anywhere, in various formats. Youwo AI quickly creates notes, automatically summarizes content, and generates quizzes and flashcards to deepen your understanding and memory.Each note can be customized using prompt templates to generate personalized summaries such as meeting minutes, action plans, study notes, content digests, press releases, blog posts, book notes, thesis outlines, and more.

🚀 Get Started Quickly:

Tap the bottom menu and choose any method to begin.

🎙️ Real-Time Recording

- Tap the 'Record' button to start immediately.

- Supports real-time multilingual speech recognition and translation.

- Add images during recording. Long-press an image to extract text or recognize formulas (LaTeX).

- Highlight key content while recording.

- Maximum duration per recording: 2 hours.

⏺️ Transcription After Recording

- Record first, transcribe later.

- Ideal for scenarios without real-time subtitles.

- Fast and accurate multilingual recognition.

- Maximum duration per recording: 3 hours.

📄 File-to-Note

- Tap 'File' to import PDF, Word, TXT, Markdown, and other formats.

- Supports extra-long PDF files and multiple office formats.

🖼️ Image-to-Note

- Take a photo or upload images to create notes.

- Supports common image formats and automatically extracts text.

🔉 Audio-to-Note

- Tap 'Audio' to import audio files and generate notes.

- Supports all mainstream audio formats.

🌐 Web Link-to-Note

- Paste a webpage or video link to instantly create notes.


- Paste a YouTube video link to import video, subtitles, and generate notes.

- Supports any video with subtitles and automatically transcribes and summarizes them.

- Type or paste text directly to generate notes in one click.

- AI Summary (customizable with prompts)

- Original Content

- AI-generated Notes
